_note: v2 hook overrides for la forêt (B27_foret). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace only hooks whose painted scene differs from the source text or that break the content rules.

fr_buche_noun.hook: A LOG rests on top of a BUSH ("BEWSH") and burns with little flames.
fr_buche_noun.why: Owner review: the log rests on a bush, on fire (replaces the campfire ring and Yule log cake).

fr_tronc_noun.why: Forest sense only: the church donation-box sense is dropped from this room.

fr_champignon_noun.why: The medal makes the 'champion' visible in the painting.

fr_feuillage_noun.why: The chameleon has to be visible in the painting, so he peeps out instead of being fully hidden.

fr_lion_noun.why: The painting shows one butterfly beside the yawn, not three flying out of the mouth.

fr_animal_noun.why: Matches the painting: the hedgehog has its turn, the fox and badger wait nearby.

fr_pou_noun.why: Painted with the nurse's giant comb; no magnifying glass.

fr_vautour_noun.why: No painted text is allowed, so the bus has no 'VOTE TOUR' slogan; the rosette and megaphone carry the 'vote'.

fr_elephant_noun.why: No monkeys are painted being blown off a branch.

fr_mammifere_noun.why: Painted as a hug in the woods, without a fairground.

fr_habitat_noun.why: The painted lodge has no beaver.

fr_hurlement_noun.why: owner: someone hurling something at a howling wolf

fr_nid_noun.why: The painted nest sits beside the boy's knee, not on it.

fr_cerf_noun.why: Owner review: no crown; the stag salutes "Sir". Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (SAIR -> SEHR).

fr_pigeon_noun.why: The source respelling trips the content filter; written pih-ZHOHN here (the card's pronunciation line is unchanged). No robins are painted.
fr_pigeon_noun.note: Same word as English, but the g is soft (zh) and the end is nasal. Un pigeon is also slang for someone easily tricked (a patsy).

fr_foret_noun.why: Owner review: the hook is four manta rays climbing a tree (replaces four rays of sunlight on a fox).

fr_oie_noun.why: Owner review: the goose cries "wah wah".
fr_oie_noun.note: Said about a person it is an insult (a silly goose).

fr_renard_noun.why: owner: renard needed a better hook

fr_pic_noun.why: owner: the woodpecker should have a pickax

fr_sanglier_noun.why: owner: the boar must visibly sing

fr_cygne_noun.why: cygnes repaint: sign now stands in the water beside the swan

fr_creature_noun.why: owner: drop the six legs the picture does not show

fr_zoo_noun.why: owner: add a cage to the zoo elephant

fr_feuille_noun.why: RECS 1.4: forest = leaf; the sheet of paper under it was painted out (paper sense: fr_feuille_noun_2 in the mairie).

fr_proie_noun.why: content fix: no praying animal; natural mouse

fr_buisson_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (bwee-SON -> bwee-SOHN).

fr_arbuste_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ar-BEWST -> ahr-BEWST).

fr_gaspard_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (gas-PAR -> gahs-PAHR).

fr_fourrure_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (foo-RUR -> foo-REWR).

fr_moustiquaire_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (moos-tee-KAIR -> moos-tee-KEHR).

fr_elan_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (ay-LON) -> (ay-LAHN) to match the card.

fr_poule_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (POOL) -> (POUL) to match the card.
fr_poule_noun.note: Said about a woman it can be disrespectful slang, though 'ma poule' between friends is a pet name.

fr_poussin_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (pou-SSIN) -> (pou-SAN) to match the card.

fr_voler_verb.why: VOLLEY of birds → voler = to fly (les oiseaux volent dans le ciel); the same verb also means to steal. RED beret = regular -er.
fr_voler_verb.note: Two meanings: to fly and to steal.

fr_percher_verb.why: Perch → percher = to perch; être perché = to be perched. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Monsieur Verbe est perché sur le poteau.
Monsieur Verbe is perched on the post.

fr_metamorphoser_verb.why: Metamorphose → métamorphoser = to transform completely; se métamorphoser = to turn into. Regular -er: RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_metamorphoses/chrysalides into foret/insectes; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
ex: Le temps métamorphose la chenille en papillon.
Time transforms the caterpillar into a butterfly.

fr_ramper_verb.why: Romper → ramper = to crawl; the mime crawls on all fours over the rug. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (rahm-PAY -> rahn-PAY). Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_navigateurs/rebonds into foret/insectes; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_pieger_verb.why: PEA-ay-zhay: trapping the pea → piéger = to trap. Regular -er (je piège): RED beret. Wave 1b oct30: moved from st_campeur/faucheurs into foret/oiseaux; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_bondir_verb.why: 'Bon deer' → bondir = to leap; the mime bounds over the fence next to the fawn. Wave 1b oct30: moved from st_departs/galopins into foret/arbres; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_serpent_noun.note: Said about a person it means a sly, treacherous person.

fr_lapin_noun.note: 'Poser un lapin' = to stand someone up.
